description: Use when a user asks what a Strong Saga guide recommends, for a guide's top picks in order, or how the picks were ranked. Returns each published buying guide with ranked_list, the guide's full numbered list in its own order read from the guide (rank, name_in_guide, label, id; picks whose main guide is another guide carry main_guide), its ranked_picks (id, guide_rank, label, name, price_text), other products from the guide outside its numbered list, and how_we_ranked quoted word for word from the guide (null when the guide has none). Pass guide (a slug like best-power-racks-under-500) for one guide, or category (from /categories) for guides covering it. Use get_home_gym_gear with an id for full specs.

category.description: Only guides that cover this category or subcategory from /categories, e.g. power_rack or walking_pad.

guide.description: One guide by slug or strongsaga.com URL, e.g. best-power-racks-under-500. Omit for all guides.

include_details.description: true adds who_its_for and skip_if from the guide text to each pick.

name: list_home_gym_guides
title: List home gym guides and their ranked picks
